answer: A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The fable counter is kept in harbor and grove shows each reset. An attacker hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1854 identities would post 553 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
